full_judgment: Abu Sayeed Ahammed J: In this case, the Rule was issued under section 561A of the CrPC for quashing the proceeding of GR No. 2973 of 1997 corresponding to Pallabi PS Case No. 1(8) of 1997 pending in the Court of Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka, wherein the charge-sheet has been submitted under sections 143 and 509 of the Penal Code against the accuseds.
